name: dev-team
description: Test-first squad: the lead owns the spec, the reviewer owns every ticket, and the tests are written before the code by an agent that never reads it to decide what to assert

members.role: Owns the spec check and every ticket; judges the tests against the spec and checks that each one has been seen to fail
Turns a spec's criteria into tests that have been seen to fail, never reading the implementation to decide what to assert
Makes the failing tests pass; may add tests, may never weaken one
Documents what a ticket changed, as its last stage
